trailhead.label: Alp Grüm station on the Bernina railway, the board’s start

cautions: A steady descent of 390 m: take it slowly with older dogs.
The path crosses the Bernina railway twice: lead short at the crossings.
Glacier lake with cold water: keep your dog out of the water near the power-plant outflow.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
